articles.title: How Cybersecurity Software Knows a Hack Is Happening
articles.summary: In July 2024, the cybersecurity firm KnowBe4 found itself in a quagmire: it had inadvertently hired a North Korean cyberattacker posing as a U.S.-based IT worker. The would-be employee had made it through four video interviews and background checks using a stolen U.S. identity and an AI-altered image. But when he accessed his company-issued laptop, things went awry. He began installing malware and manipulated his session history files to hide the actions. articles.title: How TIME and Statista Determined the Best Companies and Colleges for Future Leaders 2027
articles.summary: In the fourth edition of The Best Colleges and Companies for Future Leaders, TIME and Statista have ranked the 175 companies and 125 colleges that stand out in the career and education histories of U.S. leaders. The list draw on approximately 5,900 influential U.S.-based leaders from business, government, academia, and society. They do not measure reputation or survey opinion.
